reps.description: Number of values to generate. 0 = infinite (valid only for 'repetitive' and 'formatted' when used with -b 0)

begin.description: Lower bound: integer, float, or character (e.g. 'a', '0')

end.description: Upper bound: integer, float, or character (e.g. 'z', '255')

step.description: Increment step (float or negative for decreasing sequences)

seed.description: Random seed (used only for random mode)

word.description: Word to repeat when using -b flag

format.description: Printf-style format string (used with -w flag); e.g., '%.2f', '%c', 'item_%03d'

separator.description: String to separate values (used with -s flag)

no_final_newline.description: If true, omit the trailing newline (used with -n flag)

precision.description: Precision for output (digits after decimal or max chars; used with -p flag)

char_output.description: If true, enables character mode (-c flag); equivalent to format '%c'
